name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Code with a file name and a copy button. Bring your own highlighting, or none.

props.name: code
props.description: The code as text. This is what the copy button copies.

props.name: language
props.description: Shown in the header, e.g. "tsx" or "bash".

props.name: filename
props.description: Shown in the header instead of the language, e.g. "src/app.tsx".

props.name: children
props.description: Already highlighted markup (from Shiki or similar). Without it the plain code is shown.

a11y.text: The copy button is a native button. The code area is a scrollable pre with tabIndex 0, so it can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard.

The block is a figure with the file name, else the language, else Code as its caption. The button text lives in an aria-live polite span, so Copy becomes Copied, which resets after 1.8 seconds. Line numbers are aria-hidden and unselectable. If the clipboard is blocked, nothing changes and the code can still be selected by hand.
